description: Verifier-side cases for stored packs (pack-manifest-1). Each case is a complete stored pack: 'objects' lists every object by key with its exact bytes as text ('utf8', to be encoded as UTF-8; these packs have no binary assets), the manifest is the object at 'manifest_key'. Verify WITHOUT a trusted manifest hash. expect is {intact: true} or {error: code} with the code of the FIRST problem (order of checks: manifest canonical form, manifest structure incl. the format rule and plain-text titles, manifest key, assets, lesson positions, uniqueness, totals, then each lesson object). Every refused pack here is self-consistent (hashes, sizes and keys match), so only the rule named in the description refuses it. Written with ASCII-only JSON escapes.
